client/src/components/tables/TableRecord.name: Table records
client/src/components/tables/TableRecord.description: Lists a table's records with the columns chosen and a way into each one.

client/src/components/users/BulkActionBa.name: Selection actions bar
client/src/components/users/BulkActionBa.description: Appears when rows are selected, showing how many and what can be done to them at once.

client/src/components/users/BulkUserDial.name: Bulk people changes
client/src/components/users/BulkUserDial.description: Moves, deactivates or re-roles many people and identities at once, then reports what worked.

client/src/components/users/CreateUserDi.name: Add a person
client/src/components/users/CreateUserDi.description: Adds someone to the platform with their organization, role and sign-in setup.

client/src/components/users/EditUserDial.name: Edit a person
client/src/components/users/EditUserDial.description: Changes a person's basic details and organization.

client/src/components/users/ImpersonateU.name: Support sign-in
client/src/components/users/ImpersonateU.description: Starts a support session as another person when policy allows, so an admin can see what they see.

client/src/components/users/Registration.name: Invite link
client/src/components/users/Registration.description: Creates a one-time link someone can use to set up their account.

client/src/components/users/SelectableTa.name: Multi-select table
client/src/components/users/SelectableTa.description: Adds row checkboxes and a select-all control to lists, including on phones.

client/src/components/users/UserAccountA.name: Confirm account action
client/src/components/users/UserAccountA.description: Asks for confirmation before a sensitive account action and explains what it does.

client/src/components/users/UserActionsM.name: Person actions
client/src/components/users/UserActionsM.description: Gathers the actions available on a person, such as editing, resetting access and deactivating.

client/src/components/users/UserEmailCel.name: Email cell
client/src/components/users/UserEmailCel.description: Shows an email address neatly shortened to fit, with one-click copying.

client/src/components/users/UserLookupNo.name: Lookup notice
client/src/components/users/UserLookupNo.description: Explains why a person's details could not be found and what to do next.

client/src/components/users/UserProfileF.name: Person profile
client/src/components/users/UserProfileF.description: Edits a person's display name, status, organization and external flag where the caller is allowed.

client/src/components/users/UserRoleAssi.name: Person roles
client/src/components/users/UserRoleAssi.description: Sets a person's main role and any extra roles, with where each extra role applies.

client/src/components/users/UserStatusBa.name: Person status badge
client/src/components/users/UserStatusBa.description: Shows whether a person is active, invited or deactivated.

client/src/components/users/UsersViewTab.name: People and identities tabs
client/src/components/users/UsersViewTab.description: Switches between the list of people and the list of non-human identities.

client/src/components/users/useUserAccou.name: Account action rules
client/src/components/users/useUserAccou.description: Holds the invite, reset, sign-out, disable and delete actions for a person, with their permissions and confirmations.

client/src/components/workflows/Orphaned.name: Orphaned automations
client/src/components/workflows/Orphaned.description: Finds automations whose records have gone missing and helps an admin repair or remove them.

client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.name: Automation access
client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.description: Shows who an automation runs as on its own, what access it still needs, and where each run reaches.

client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.name: Automation settings
client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.description: Edits an automation's details, limits, running costs, tools, access and public link in one place.

client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.name: Automations list
client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.description: Lists automations with their state, owner and last run, and opens the one you pick.

client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.name: Automation inputs
client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.description: Collects the values an automation needs before it runs.

client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.name: Choose an automation
client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.description: Lets an admin pick an automation for a record and warns when its access does not match.

client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.name: Automation filters
client/src/components/workflows/Workflow.description: Filters automations by category and by which forms, apps or agents use them.
